notes: The text opens «قال سفيان» with no written head, so Sufyan is the first named link.
«فإنه حدثناه عن جابر» is a rival transmitter claim for the same saying: stored as a variant group, not a route.
«حديث عطاء» is the hadith's name, not a link; Ata enters the chain at «حفظناه من عطاء عن ابن عباس».
